adaptedNarrationEditScript.safetyPreamble: This draft is a reflective guided practice, not medical advice, diagnosis, therapy, or a promise of any outcome. Pause or stop if it feels distressing; seek qualified support for health or eating concerns.
script: Welcome. Let this be a moment to notice your relationship with food without judging it.
You may remember one ordinary meal that felt settled or nourishing. Nothing has to change today; simply notice what felt supportive.
If difficult feelings arrive, return to a comfortable breath, open your eyes, or end the practice. Your wellbeing comes first.
Carry forward only what is useful: one small moment of self-compassion at your next meal.
